title: gravitas.ledger/1
description: The evidence ledger a submission token carries as `ev` (a record, never a file by itself): the SHA-256 digest of the ledger (`d`), the ids of the envelopes it was made from (`i`), how many rows the ledger has (`n`) and the rows of the evidence table (`r`, cut to the token's limit), each row nine columns (envelope id, quantity id, value, unit, uncertainty, origin, source kind, source id, a 16-digit data digest) and a tenth, the uncertainty's code, when one is stated. js/submission/ledgerDigest.js checkEvidence() is the authority: it recomputes the digest from the ids and rows and says verified, partial (`n` beyond the rows carried) or mismatch; it verifies structure, not who made the table. A reader of nine columns reads every row it ever did. FORMATS.md lists it.
